concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-authorization-client-token]] - signed client-token purpose, server-to-client initialization roles, application-communication scope, and stated validity and invalidation boundaries
warnings: Keep authorization scoped to authenticating the application for direct client-SDK communication; do not present the client token as transaction authorization or evidence of payment success.

Preserve 'up to 24 hours' rather than promising a full 24-hour lifetime; customer-ID invalidation is conditioned on excessive payment-method creation, and the page states neither a numeric threshold nor a fixed reuse count.
